verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The AI material describes an MCP server and Agent Skills that let external assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) query SigNoz data. That is a different capability, owned by the separate MCP and agent stories, and does not count as AI insights inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
